title: StackTok: Accelerating VLMs Inference with Budget-Adaptive Visual Token Selection
abstract: arXiv:2609.16841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Increasing image resolution produces ever-longer visual-token sequences in vision-language models (VLMs), substantially raising their inference cost. To reduce this overhead without retraining, existing methods select compact token subsets that prioritize query relevance, visual coverage, or a fixed trade-off between them. The appropriate balance, however, varies across queries and token budgets: localized questions favor relevance, whereas holistic questions demand broader visual coverage. We introduce StackTok, a training-free selector that treats query relevance as the objective and visual coverage as budget-calibrated support. StackTok builds a size-indexed coverage reference from a coverage-only greedy sequence and adjusts its support target using query--vision affinity entropy. A reference-gated interleaved selection policy then switches between relevance- and coverage-oriented additions according to the current subset's support

translated_title: StackTok：通过预算自适应的视觉令牌选择加速视觉语言模型推理
translated_abstract: 提高图像分辨率会在视觉语言模型（VLM）中产生越来越长的视觉令牌序列，从而大幅增加其推理成本。为了在不重新训练的情况下减少这种开销，现有方法选择紧凑的令牌子集，这些方法优先考虑查询相关性、视觉覆盖率，或两者之间固定的权衡。然而，合适的平衡因查询和令牌预算而异：局部性问题偏好相关性，而整体性问题则需要更广泛的视觉覆盖率。我们提出了StackTok，这是一种无需训练的选择器，它将查询相关性作为目标，将视觉覆盖率作为预算校准的支持。StackTok从仅基于覆盖率的贪心序列构建一个按大小索引的覆盖率参考，并使用查询-视觉亲和度熵来调整其支持目标。然后，一种参考门控的交错选择策略根据当前子集的支持情况，在面向相关性和面向覆盖率的添加之间进行切换。
tldr: StackTok提出了一种无需训练的视觉令牌选择方法，将查询相关性作为目标、视觉覆盖率作为预算校准的支持，通过参考门控的交错选择策略自适应平衡两者，从而在不重新训练的情况下加速视觉语言模型的推理。
en_tdlr: StackTok is a training-free visual token selector that treats query relevance as the objective and visual coverage as budget-calibrated support, adaptively balancing the two via a reference-gated interleaved selection policy to accelerate VLM inference without retraining.
